evidence_quotes: vergunning op grond van de Wet natuurbescherming (hierna: Wnb)
schadelijke effecten hebben op nabijgelegen Natura 2000-gebieden.
rationale: Dutch administrative appeal (RvS) concerning a refusal to take enforcement action against a business in Slagharen for allegedly operating without a Nature Conservation Act (Wet natuurbescherming / Wnb) permit affecting nearby Natura 2000 areas. The dispute concerns nature conservation permitting rather than water law, water infrastructure, or water/sanitation services.
